+TARGET = np.array([0.640, -0.280, 0.962])

+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 0.609231, 0.792994, 0.0], dtype=float)
+Q_DOWN /= np.linalg.norm(Q_DOWN)
+

+def slerp(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
+    a = a / np.linalg.norm(a)
+    b = b / np.linalg.norm(b)
+    dot = float(np.dot(a, b))
+    if dot < 0:
+        b, dot = -b, -dot
+    if dot > 0.9995:
+        q = a + t * (b - a)
+        return q / np.linalg.norm(q)
+    theta = math.acos(float(np.clip(dot, -1.0, 1.0)))
+    return (math.sin((1 - t) * theta) * a + math.sin(t * theta) * b) / math.sin(theta)
